definitions.explanation: The act of bathing, especially soaking in a bathtub or hot spring. More formal than お{風呂|ふろ}に{入|はい}る, often used in written instructions, medical contexts, and facility signage.

examples.japanese: {食事|しょくじ}の{前|まえ}に{入浴|にゅうよく}する。
examples.english: Take a bath before the meal.

examples.japanese: {入浴|にゅうよく}{後|ご}は{水分|すいぶん}を{補給|ほきゅう}してください。
この{温泉|おんせん}{旅館|りょかん}では、{露天風呂|ろてんぶろ}での{入浴|にゅうよく}が{楽|たの}しめる。
examples.english: At this hot spring inn, you can enjoy bathing in an open-air bath.

notes:
A formal word for bathing. In everyday conversation, お{風呂|ふろ}に{入|はい}る is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{入浴|にゅうよく}する (take a bath)
・{入浴|にゅうよく}{剤|ざい} (bath salts/additives)
・{入浴|にゅうよく}{時間|じかん} (bathing time)
・{入浴|にゅうよく}{後|ご} (after bathing)
・{入浴|にゅうよく}{中|ちゅう} (currently bathing)
・{入浴|にゅうよく}{介助|かいじょ} (bathing assistance — nursing/care context)

In medical and caregiving contexts, {入浴|にゅうよく} is the standard term rather than the casual お{風呂|ふろ}.
